Alpine Prism.name: Alpine Prism
Alpine Prism.label: A QUIET PEAK UNDER GLASS
Alpine Prism.description: A tall glass prism holding a calm alpine scene of preserved moss and a small deer figure. Needs no water and no sunlight.

Diamond Prism.name: Diamond Prism
Diamond Prism.label: STONE AND MOSS, FACETED
Diamond Prism.description: A faceted glass prism filled with lush preserved moss and natural stone, built to be a centrepiece on any desk or shelf.

Ganesha's Pod.name: Ganesha's Pod
Ganesha's Pod.label: A GREEN HOME FOR GANESHA
Ganesha's Pod.description: A Ganesha idol resting in a bed of preserved moss under a glass pod. A calm, low-care gift for homes and offices.

Nature's Dome.name: Nature's Dome
Nature's Dome.label: A TINY FOREST UNDER A DOME
Nature's Dome.description: A miniature forest of preserved moss and bark set under a glass dome on a gold base. Fits in the palm of your hand.

Nature's Prism.name: Nature's Prism
Nature's Prism.label: OUR SIGNATURE PRISM
Nature's Prism.description: A geometric glass prism with layers of preserved moss, bark and stone. A living-looking landscape that never needs care.

Terra GlowPod.name: Terra GlowPod
Terra GlowPod.label: MOSS THAT GLOWS AT NIGHT
Terra GlowPod.description: A tall glass terrarium on a dark base with a warm light in the lid, so your moss landscape glows softly after dark.

The Pod.name: The Pod
The Pod.label: SMALL POD, BIG CALM
The Pod.description: A compact glass pod with preserved moss — a simple way to bring green to a desk or bedside table.

Wooden base with Warm Light.name: Wooden Base with Warm Light
Wooden base with Warm Light.label: LIGHT UP YOUR TERRARIUM
Wooden base with Warm Light.description: A wooden base with a built-in warm light that sits under your terrarium and makes it glow.
